Hi Elena — Diego from Support here. Thanks for sending the authorization. To be precise about scope and timing, here is our standard single-conversation redaction runbook (summarized):

1) Validation: Confirm tenant identifier (last 4) + request ID. We log the authorization in the case record.
2) Active data removal: Remove the conversation from the search index and the active token request logs. This takes effect immediately after the run.
3) KV/prefix caches: Evict any cached KV or prefix entries referenced by the request ID.
4) Audit and proof: Generate a deletion audit file and signed certificate, attach to SUP case.
5) Backups & snapshots: Snapshots and offsite backups are on a 30-day rotation. We will schedule an expedited scrub from our backup tier where possible; however, depending on the backup provider and snapshot schedule, full removal from backups can take up to 30 days. We will include a note in the certificate about any residual snapshot window.

Please confirm the tenant last-4 digits and whether you accept the backup removal window. Once we have that I will schedule the redaction and share the deletion token and audit.
